items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I call her Noel Coward, with the strange humor...

ctx.x: My daughter Sharon is the first one who got us all together. I call her Noel Coward, with the strange humor... She had a party, and Emma, my first wife, and Toni, my second wife, and my present wife, we were all at this party. Well, in the beginning I was a little uncomfortable, but I figured, 'What the hell?' I hadn't done bad by anybody. I left them all with nice houses.
